elevate.move: Drive the story-pole tick highlight with ScrollTrigger so the active tick physically slides to each section's height mark as the visitor scrolls, and tie the clip-wipe direction on tool images to the ruler's vertical axis (top-to-bottom reveals instead of generic left-to-right). This makes the signature the motion language rather than a static decoration, and adds a fourth distinct hook type beyond reveal/clip/split.

Replace the plain-text estimator output with a small SVG elevation drawing that updates in real time as inputs change — for the built-in planner, draw the wall with bay divisions and shelf lines; for the molding picker, show the profile silhouette scaled to the entered perimeter. The output becomes a designed artifact in the story-pole's drafting language, something a homeowner would screenshot or print, and connects the tool directly to the signature's visual vocabulary.
